caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture, specifically a small table with a storage compartment. The table is brown in color with a polished wood texture. It stands on four curved legs, each ending in a small caster wheel. The legs are ornate and have a slight scroll at the top and bottom. There is a flat rectangular shelf connecting the legs near the base. The top section of the table is a box-like compartment with beveled edges. On the front of the compartment are two gold or brass-colored handles and a central keyhole. At the top right of the drawing, a second view shows the box compartment open, revealing a lined interior with divided sections and a dark, slanted writing surface, as well as the lid propped open. The hardware on the box, including the handles and the lock, is depicted in a metallic yellow color, contrasting with the wood. The drawing is rendered on a plain, light beige background.
title: Writing or Sewing Table
